svg.title: Excavation sump pumping — Dæling úr uppgraftarholu
svg.desc: A compact pump stands in water at the bottom of a sloped construction excavation, with a hose rising to the edge.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-excavation-sump-pump","label_en":"Excavation sump pumping","label_is":"Dæling úr uppgraftarholu","section":"04","category_en":"Excavation, foundations and ground engineering","category_is":"Uppgröftur, undirstöður og jarðtækni","batch":2,"tags":["groundwater","dewatering"],"description":"A compact pump stands in water at the bottom of a sloped construction excavation, with a hose rising to the edge.","design_note":"A visible sloping earth cut and open collected water separate this temporary sump from a permanent building pump pit.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
